Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: Sent to indicate the start and end of the day.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Start or end of day event code.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Message.Name: Instrument Directory Message
Message.Description: Used to disseminate a common and limited set of data for all configured instrument types, except strategy instruments, on the real-time channels.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: GTP Instrument identifier.

Field.Name: ISIN
Field.Description: ISIN Code of an instrument.

Field.Name: Allowed Book Types
Field.Description: Defines the order-book types that are allowed for the instrument. Each designated bit represents a book type. '0' means not allowed and '1' means allowed.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Venue Instrument ID
Field.Description: Instrument identifier used by the source venue.

Field.Name: Tick ID
Field.Description: The tick structure applicable for the instrument.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Dynamic Circuit Breaker Tolerances (%)
Field.Description: Dynamic Circuit Breaker Tolerance (%) of the instrument.

Field.Name: Static Circuit Breaker Tolerances (%)
Field.Description: Static Circuit Breaker Tolerance (%) of the instrument.

Field.Name: Segment
Field.Description: Segment the instrument is assigned to.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Currency Code as per ISO 4217.

Field.Name: Partition ID
Field.Description: Trading System's partition in which the instrument is traded.

Field.Name: Reserved Field
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Average Daily Turnover (ADT)
Field.Description: Not Applicable to LSE.

Message.Name: Instrument Status Message
Message.Description: Used to communicate scheduled and unscheduled session changes. When sent in the recovery channel, used to indicate the current trading status of an instrument.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: GTP Instrument identifier.

Field.Name: Source venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Trading Status
Field.Description: Current trading status of the instrument.

Field.Name: Session Change Reason
Field.Description: Reason the trading session changed.

Field.Name: New End Time
Field.Description: New time the session will end. The field will contain only spaces if Session Change Reason is '0' or the Session Change Reason is not present. New End Time will be in terms of the local time on the server (i.e., not UTC).

Field.Name: Order Book Type
Field.Description: Order book the status applies to.

Message.Name: Analytics Message
Message.Description: Analytics Message is used to disseminate additional statistics including order book activity statistics.

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Time the message was generated.

Field.Name: Instrument
Field.Description: GTP Instrument identifier.

Field.Name: Source Venue
Field.Description: Venue from which market data is received for the instrument.

Field.Name: Start Time
Field.Description: Time the calculation of the statistics on this message began.

Field.Name: End Time
Field.Description: Time the calculation of the statistics on this message ended.

Field.Name: Buy Order Count
Field.Description: Number of buy orders received within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Sell Order Count
Field.Description: Number of sell orders received within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Buy Order Size
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of all buy orders received within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Sell Order Size
Field.Description: Cumulative quantity of all sell orders received within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Buy Order Cancellations
Field.Description: Number of buy orders cancelled by clients within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Sell Order Cancellations
Field.Description: Number of sell orders cancelled by clients within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Buy Limit Order Cancellations
Field.Description: Number of buy limit orders cancelled by clients within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Buy Market Order Cancellations
Field.Description: Number of buy market orders cancelled by clients within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Sell Limit Order Cancellations
Field.Description: Number of sell limit orders cancelled by clients within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Sell Market Order Cancellations
Field.Description: Number of sell market orders cancelled by clients within the calculation window.

Field.Name: Bid Ask Spread
Field.Description: Most Recent Bid/Ask spread at the time of publication of the message. If the value is set to zero, this means, either: 1) No sell/buy liquidity 2) Order book is locked or crossed 3) No orders on order book.

Field.Name: VWAP Buy
Field.Description: Volume Weighted Average Price for trades triggered by an aggressing buy order. Calculated within the calculation window for trades executed in continuous trading.

Field.Name: VWAP Sell
Field.Description: Volume Weighted Average Price for trades triggered by an aggressing sell order. Calculated within the calculation window for trades executed in continuous trading.

Bitfield.Name: Allowed Book Types
Bitfield.Description: Defines the order-book types that are allowed for the instrument
